beast.sight:woolback: We live on the wild sheep. They are horned, in heavy coats, and graze the grass and the open wood two to four together. By dusk they are off the open ground.
beast.kill:woolback: Meat, fat and a hide. Nothing in it boils down to lees, because it is an ordinary animal of this ground and no feeder.
beast.habit:woolback: Two to four graze together on open grass by day. A struck one runs. By dusk the herd has left the open.
beast.once:woolback: One was grazing between the doors of an empty village, beside the well. The flocks walk right up to the old houses.
beast.sight:gobblet: These birds walk the woods, the grass and the wet ground by day. They are brown, pale in the head, and stand as high as the knee. We take them for meat and feathers.
beast.kill:gobblet: A little meat and a handful of feathers. There was no lees in it, since a bird is no feeder.
beast.habit:gobblet: It keeps to the woods, the grass and wet country by day, and runs from anyone who strikes it.
beast.once:gobblet: Our first arrows from the workbench were fletched with its feathers. Most arrows take them.
beast.sight:burrowhog: By day the boar roots in the cold woods, on the crags and out on the snow. It is brown and tusked, and one carries more meat than anything else we hunt.
beast.kill:burrowhog: Meat in plenty and a thick hide. Nothing of it boiled down.
beast.habit:burrowhog: One to three root together in cold woods, on crags and in snow country while the sun is up. None is left in the open by dusk.
beast.once:burrowhog: One was rooting in the snow of Sānu at noon, and nothing else was out on the snow anywhere in sight. By day the boar has that country to itself.
beast.sight:dune_skipper: The sand people live on this hare. It runs on the sand and the dry grass by day, long in the ear and the colour of the sand.
beast.kill:dune_skipper: A hide and a little meat, and no lees. It is an ordinary animal, and hard to catch.
beast.habit:dune_skipper: Hares are out only by day, on the sand and the dry grass. A struck one is away at once.
beast.once:dune_skipper: Hares were the only thing on the sand of Marudesha by day while Maruhar still lived. Nothing hostile shared it with them.
beast.sight:glimmerfin: In the sea and the channels these fish swim by night and by day, and their scales shine. Nothing comes up in water, so no feeder swims with them.
beast.kill:glimmerfin: Raw flesh and fine bones, and it pays nothing. No feeder takes a body in water, so whatever swims is an ordinary animal.
beast.habit:glimmerfin: Shoals of two to five keep together in any open water and turn as one.
beast.once:glimmerfin: A feeder that was after one of us came to the edge of the water and stopped there. The fish went on swimming round our legs.
beast.sight:gloomshade: Tama come up everywhere at night, and in the caves at all hours. They are dark and upright, the height of a person. Anything dead left on the ground brings them.
beast.kill:gloomshade: Bone, and a dark raw flesh that is the matter of other feeders it has eaten. One had a long bone in it of a kind no grazing animal here has.
beast.habit:gloomshade: Tama come up at night over the whole living ground, and in the caves at any hour. A lamp does not turn one that is already up, and it walks into the light. Full sun takes it apart.
beast.once:gloomshade: One came out of the brood nest in a Broken Store at midday and fell apart at the wall in the sun. The nest puts them out by day as well.
beast.sight:thornling: Kantak pass for bushes by day: waist-high bramble and sapling with a red bud on top. At night they walk.
beast.kill:thornling: Thorn and plant fibre. It eats green growth and is made of it, and nothing else came out.
beast.habit:thornling: Kantak stand still among the bushes by day until a body comes within fourteen strides. After dark they walk.
beast.once:thornling: One went down at our walls in a Night raid. Since Vanahar was killed, its packs come for the stores at dusk.
beast.sight:gelcap: Their jelly is what goes into the offering for Vanahar. Kinva sit in the grass by day, knee-high and red-skinned, and hop at anyone who comes near.
beast.kill:gelcap: Nothing under the skin but jelly. It has no shape of its own inside.
beast.habit:gelcap: Kinva sit on one patch until something disturbs them. Where one sat, the tall grass is gone.
beast.once:gelcap: Our first Vanahar Likeness took two lumps of its jelly. Laid on the stone, the likeness brings Vanahar up for what is in it.
beast.sight:bog_lurker: Out in the mud of Panka they lie sunk to the head, by day as by night. Come close and one stands up, chest-high, reed and peat with roots trailing.
beast.kill:bog_lurker: Reed fibre and peat, and the bones of whatever had died in the mud where it lay.
beast.habit:bog_lurker: Kaddam lie sunk in the mud with only the head showing until something comes near. They come up in mud and never in open water.
beast.once:bog_lurker: One dropped a Lees Lump in Panka. It had come up out of the mud with the lump inside it.
beast.sight:frost_stalker: On the snow, in the pine woods and on the peaks, Vaka hunt at night, one to three together. They run on four legs, pale, and see a person a long way off.
beast.kill:frost_stalker: Hide, and now and then a long tooth. The hide that came off it is the hide of what it had run down.
beast.habit:frost_stalker: Vaka hunt cold country at night. One sees a body from twenty-four strides and comes straight in.
beast.once:frost_stalker: One stood in full sun on the snow of Hima at midday, a little way off, unharmed. It must have taken its body from the cold of this ground, under the sun.
beast.sight:cinder_wisp: Over the fires of the sand people there are always Angār, because they come to warm ash. At night these live coals hang over the sand and throw embers.
beast.kill:cinder_wisp: When it went out, a little Ember Dust fell where it had hung. There was no body round the coal. The dust burns twice as long as coal does.
beast.habit:cinder_wisp: An Angār hangs in the air ten strides off and throws embers. It comes no closer.
beast.once:cinder_wisp: One hung beside molten rock deep under the living ground in the middle of the day. The coal that comes up on the sand at night is down there whatever the hour.
beast.sight:stonegnawer: Every depth we have dug to, from the turf nearly to the floor, has these in it. They go low on six legs, plated in scale the colour of the stone.
beast.kill:stonegnawer: Plates of Stone Scale and lumps of coal. It eats rock, and coal where it finds it.
beast.habit:stonegnawer: Silahādak are the commonest thing under the ground. We meet them at every depth from the floor up to the turf.
beast.once:stonegnawer: We killed one beside the nest in a Sealed Store, where pieces of the dressed walls are missing in clean gaps. This kind breeds in the stores and has been at the stone.
beast.sight:cave_skitter: We meet them in packs in the caves: small dark crawlers on eight legs, quick on the rock.
beast.kill:cave_skitter: Fibre and nothing else: old cord, sacking, threads. Whatever fibre it found went into its body.
beast.habit:cave_skitter: Packs of two to four run on the cave rock, small and fast.
beast.once:cave_skitter: One died on Fungal Turf on the living ground, and inside it was all white thread, the kind fungus puts through rock. Where nobody has worked, it takes its body from that thread.
beast.sight:crag_bat: Because they roost, a held hearth turns these bats as it turns anything that walks. They hang in the caves, and at night they fly over the crags and the peaks.
beast.kill:crag_bat: Feather and scraps of hide, from the birds and small animals it takes.
beast.habit:crag_bat: It hangs in the caves by day and by night, and flies over the high rock of Pabbat and Sānu after dark.
beast.once:crag_bat: One came down out of the night sky over Pabbat and died in the open. It was the same animal we meet in the caves.
beast.sight:rustbound: It stands in the rooms of the Sealed Stores, rust-red plates on a grey frame, as tall as a big man, and throws bolts of rust.
beast.kill:rustbound: Rust lumps, iron bars and barbed arrows. Opened over the pot, it had no bone anywhere in it.
beast.habit:rustbound: One that came from a nest goes no more than ten strides from it. It throws its rust from twelve strides.
beast.once:rustbound: A Barbed Arrow came out of one in a Sealed Store. It had eaten the harness and arrows stored there. The born say it was posted there.
beast.sight:sporeling: The hollow is full of them: fungus caps up to the knee, glowing from inside, that hop about.
beast.kill:sporeling: Spore sacs, and sometimes the mushroom itself. It has no body of its own beyond the cap it forms in.
beast.habit:sporeling: Every Kavak near enough to hear comes for whoever strikes one of them.
beast.once:sporeling: One left a Glowing Mushroom where it died in the hollow. It was the cap it had formed in.
beast.sight:mycelid_knight: Two strides of fungus stand up in the hollow, with a cap at the top, plates on the body and one limb grown out into an edge.
beast.kill:mycelid_knight: Spore sacs, bone and Antar ore. The plates on it were Antar it had taken up from the rock.
beast.habit:mycelid_knight: Asikavak go alone or in pairs. They are slow and hard to knock back.
beast.once:mycelid_knight: One went down beside the nest in a Vault of the hollow. They breed where the lees was stored.
beast.sight:umbral_moth: Over the great caps of the hollow something flies on broad dark wings, violet at the edges, and throws dust down from a little way off.
beast.kill:umbral_moth: Moth Dust, and almost nothing under it. Its body was the dust that falls from the great caps.
beast.habit:umbral_moth: It never lands. It throws dust from nine strides.
beast.once:umbral_moth: We tied its dust to our first Jīmūt Kite. The kite carries the dust up into the air, where the great flier feeds.
beast.sight:glowmaw: It came at us fast across the hollow on four legs, long in the jaw, with a light along its back and tail.
beast.kill:glowmaw: Hide and spore sacs. It eats the hopping caps, and the light along its back comes from them.
beast.habit:glowmaw: Sagāl run fast across the hollow, one or two together. The light on the back shows one coming.
beast.once:glowmaw: One dropped a lump of Tala Ore in the hollow. It had eaten something that had been at the lower rock, it seems.
beast.sight:rift_ray: It comes over the islands on broad blue scaled wings, with a long tail behind. The bat and the moth are the same make of flier, filled with other matter.
beast.kill:rift_ray: Vihanga Scale. It feeds on the undersides of the pale sheets that hang under the islands and on what falls from the rims.
beast.habit:rift_ray: Vihanga are in the air over the islands at all hours. One stoops on a body from above.
beast.once:rift_ray: One came at us from under the rim of an island, far below where we stood. It rides under the rim and rises over it.
beast.sight:shardling: Among the spires of the islands stand bodies of splintered pale crystal, a person's height and twice as broad. Until one moves we cannot tell it from a spire.
beast.kill:shardling: Shards, and now and then Patik Ore. Its whole body was crystal like the spires it stands among.
beast.habit:shardling: A Sakal does not move until it has someone to go for. It is slow and very hard.
beast.once:shardling: A piece of Patik Ore dropped from one. The crystal kinds feed on the seams of that ore and carry bits of it in their bodies.
beast.sight:aether_wisp: Something bright moves through the air over the islands with nothing holding it. It is crystal. The outlines of things go soft round it, as over a hot stone, and it throws pieces of crystal.
beast.kill:aether_wisp: Crystal fell where it had hung, and nothing else. There was no body round it.
beast.habit:aether_wisp: A Kajjot throws crystal from twelve strides and keeps that distance.
beast.once:aether_wisp: A Vihanga Scale fell from one on the islands. It had been feeding on a dead Vihanga.
beast.sight:moonspawn: The moon is hollow on the dark night, and these come down out of it: pale walkers taller than a Tama, with a violet light of their own.
beast.kill:moonspawn: Shade Flesh from what it had eaten, and Moon Slivers broken off its own body.
beast.habit:moonspawn: It never goes down before dawn. The sun undoes every one still standing.
beast.once:moonspawn: At sunrise one stood in the open and came apart. Its kind has never had to go down before a dawn, it seems.
beast.sight:lunar_howler: Nothing in the air is quicker than an Ulūk. They are pale fliers, and they come down with the walkers on the dark night.
beast.kill:lunar_howler: Moon Slivers and little else, the same pale set lees as the walkers of the dark night.
beast.habit:lunar_howler: Ulūk are in the air only on the dark night. They go where the walkers go.
beast.once:lunar_howler: One was still in the air at dawn, and the sun took it apart as it takes the walkers.
beast.sight:sproutling: Once Vanahar is half spent, small walkers of sprout and sapling come up round the stone, green and knee-high.
beast.kill:sproutling: Nothing. They had fed on nothing yet, and the pot got nothing from them.
beast.habit:sproutling: Paroha are slow and fight only at close quarters. They come up round the stone and nowhere else.
beast.once:sproutling: Vanahar went back down at its altar with Paroha still on the floor, and they went with it.
beast.sight:dune_mite: When Maruhar thrashes, crawlers of grit come off its body, plated, on six legs, the colour of sand.
beast.kill:dune_mite: Empty grit. They live between the burrower's plates and had eaten nothing of their own, so there was no lees.
beast.habit:dune_mite: They come off the burrower when it thrashes, and leave nothing behind when killed.
beast.once:dune_mite: Maruhar went back under the sand at its altar while Kīta were still on the floor. None of them was left on the sand afterwards.
beast.sight:ashen_raider: Sand people with blades march on peopls' houses at first light, grey with the ash of their own fires. They go for what is stored and go home at dusk.
beast.kill:ashen_raider: He carried a Mūda, a grey token broken from the glass under one of their fires, and now and then an iron bar. The lees on him had been taken on the way, for the fire.
beast.habit:ashen_raider: He fights with a blade, comes with the Sand March at dawn, and goes home at dusk.
beast.once:ashen_raider: A fighter of theirs fell at our walls during a Night raid. A few of his people now come in behind the dusk packs, to reach a store while the pack has us busy.
beast.sight:ashen_hexer: His people burn a kill where it lies, with a long iron whose head is a basket of pitch. On a march he throws that burning pitch at the peopls.
beast.kill:ashen_hexer: He carried Mūda, and the long iron with its basket head packed with pitch and Ember Dust.
beast.habit:ashen_hexer: He throws burning pitch from thirteen strides and does not close.
beast.once:ashen_hexer: One carried a Crystal from one of our stores. A march takes what it finds for the fire, and crystal is lees to them.
beast.sight:siege_brute: The biggest of a march comes behind the rest, in thick padding, with a beam for doors and chests.
beast.kill:siege_brute: He carried more Mūda than the rest of the march, and iron.
beast.habit:siege_brute: He is the biggest of the march, slow and hard to knock back.
beast.once:siege_brute: He came up to our walls last on a Sand March, when half the march was already there.
beast.sight:m_thornling: When we first drove the bones of the Iron Totem, a green lump the size of a fist came off it, with one red thorn.
beast.kill:m_thornling: It struck its first feeder down as hard as iron would. Its body is the iron of the totem head.
beast.habit:m_thornling: Sūlak is the slowest of the kinds that form on a totem. With nothing to fight, it circles a little above the bearer's head.
beast.once:m_thornling: One of us went down at night with it out. The totem came through to the bed with the body, food and all, and the lump was gone from the ground.
beast.sight:m_wisp: Hīrak gives it its colour. What forms on the Hīrak Totem is a point of that colour with no shape beyond the point, and it hangs beside the bearer.
beast.kill:m_wisp: Its blows land as hard as gem. It took its body from the Hīrak of the totem head.
beast.habit:m_wisp: Within eighteen strides of its bearer, the Kanik goes for any feeder it finds.
beast.once:m_wisp: When its bearer stepped through the Hollow Gate, the point of colour did not come through. Another formed in the hollow when the bones were driven again.
beast.sight:m_brazier: An ember hangs in the air beside the Jalit Totem. Its body is the Jalit of the totem head, and its food is the Shade Flesh bound to the bones.
beast.kill:m_brazier: Its blows came as hard as Jalit, and a Tama went down under them.
beast.habit:m_brazier: Once a feeder is twenty-four strides from the bearer, the Jālak lets it go and comes back.
beast.once:m_brazier: A Jālak went after an Angār that hung far out over the sand. Once the Angār was a long way from the bearer, the ember turned back.
beast.sight:m_shade: Round the one holding the Antar Totem flies a small dark thing with violet at the edges of its wings.
beast.kill:m_shade: In the hollow it took down a feeder by itself. Nobody had pointed it at anything.
beast.habit:m_shade: The Jatuk has no throw. It strikes by touching the feeder, and strikes again almost at once.
beast.once:m_shade: A Jatuk flew straight through the wall of a Sealed Store to reach a Nihirakka on the other side.
beast.sight:m_mycelid: Teal is the colour of Tala Ore, and the cap that formed on the Tala Totem is that teal. It is small and glows, with a dark band round it.
beast.kill:m_mycelid: The feeder it killed lay on the ground like any other kill, with its own remains in it. We boiled that kill down as usual.
beast.habit:m_mycelid: One hand carries one Chattak at a time, or two with a Whistle or a worn piece. When one more forms than the hand allows, the first is gone.
beast.once:m_mycelid: When its bearer fell deep in the hollow, the little cap was gone at once.
beast.sight:m_zephyr: With the Ākās Totem comes a small white flier, blue at the wings, that stays over the bearer's shoulder.
beast.kill:m_zephyr: It brought a feeder down over the islands and was still beside the bearer afterwards. It is Ākās through and through.
beast.habit:m_zephyr: Blows from feeders pass through a Setasalaha. Nothing we have seen has hurt one.
beast.once:m_zephyr: A Setasalaha went for a Vihanga that was stooping on its bearer, and the Vihanga took no notice of it and came on.
beast.sight:m_shardling: It looks like a Sakal made small: a glowing splinter, pale pink. It formed on the raw remains bound to the bones of the Patik Totem.
beast.kill:m_shardling: A Sakal fell to it among the spires. It hits as hard as Patik, the metal of its totem head.
beast.habit:m_shardling: However far behind it is left, the Sakalak is beside its bearer again at once, without crossing the ground between.
beast.once:m_shardling: A Sakalak and a wild Sakal met among the spires. The small one went for the big one as it goes for any feeder.
beast.sight:m_moon: The Gahan Totem has a dark thing on four legs at its side, a hand high, with pale tines and a pale tail. It runs on the air.
beast.kill:m_moon: It ran a Vaka down and killed it. Gahan is the hardest metal we have, and that is its body.
beast.habit:m_moon: For all its four legs, the Harinak keeps to the air like the rest. Rock and walls do not stop it on the way to a feeder.
beast.once:m_moon: On the dark night a Harinak went for the Chandasāvak at our walls, as it would for any other feeder.
beast.sight:m_cairn: A point of yellow light hangs by the lamp at the head of this totem. That lamp was taken from the housing of the Cairn. The point is larger than the one off the Hīrak Totem.
beast.kill:m_cairn: A Silahādak went down to it beside a Cairn. Its blows are the hardest of any that form on a totem.
beast.habit:m_cairn: Dīpik moves faster than any other kind that forms on a totem, faster even than a Harinak.
beast.once:m_cairn: Dīpik went for a Silahādak that was coming up out of the broken base of a Cairn.
eight.sight:b_colossus: Root, bark and moss made a body larger than anything else in the wood. Its roots went down into the joints of the paving and up the six oaks of the floor. Each footfall could be heard.
eight.kill:b_colossus: Root and wood came out of it, and worked iron bars with them. Nothing in a wood makes bars. Vanahar Remains still moved in the hand after the kill.
eight.loss:b_colossus: Every hostile thing we met was harder to kill from the day it died. Some dusks later Tama and Kantak were round our houses in twos and threes, going for the stores until dawn.
eight.habit:b_colossus: Each bait laid at its stone has brought one up, as large as the first. Close in, it stamps and the paving heaves. Further off, it runs at us.
eight.once:b_colossus: Behind an oak of the floor, its charge stopped at the trunk. The oak stood. Those oaks are older than any other tree in the wood.
eight.said:b_colossus: The forebears set Vanahar over Vana when the stones were raised. Lees from it turns everything of the woods that walks. Vana comes back to us with it.
eight.intro:b_colossus: Roots push up between the paving stones.
eight.phase:b_colossus.1: Roots rip up out of the paving in a ring round it.
eight.sight:b_maw: Only the rim and the gilded platform gave a footing over the loose sand. A long body of segments rose through the sand, made of grit and shedding grit as it came.
eight.kill:b_maw: Grit from end to end, round a middle of the rock that forms beside molten rock. The gold of the lures was still gold.
eight.loss:b_maw: Sand people grey with ash marched on our houses at dawn and turned for home at dusk. Other kinds now rise out of the sand of Marudesha at night.
eight.habit:b_maw: Whoever steps onto the sand has it come up beneath them, throwing grit. Badly hurt, it stays above the sand.
eight.once:b_maw: Kīta were on the floor of the bowl before Maruhar came up. They ran to the place where it would surface and were there first.
eight.said:b_maw: Maruhar kept everything else off the sand, so the sand people could live there without a pot. Under a fire its remains work Jalit Ore.
eight.intro:b_maw: The sand in the bowl begins to move.
eight.phase:b_maw.1: Out of the sand now, the body thrashes and sheds grit.
eight.sight:b_warden: Slow lumps drifted at us in threes. They came off a pale upright body hanging over the bell on the stone. Between throws it was in another place.
eight.kill:b_warden: Its body was pale set matter, with Hīrak running through it in lumps. Kankāl's kind takes its body in the dark of the hollow, where no sun reaches.
eight.loss:b_warden: Chandasāvak and Ulūk came up over the whole country on the first dark night after the kill, and the sky went violet. Every other pack stayed off the ground that night. The sun took apart every one still standing.
eight.habit:b_warden: No Night raid reached our houses while it was up. Its lumps come in threes at first, and they are slow enough to step round.
eight.once:b_warden: We killed it with the Tama still on the floor. They had come in to eat it as it failed. We stood between.
eight.said:b_warden: Kankāl lay on a seal in the deep rock. The peopls broke the seal when they killed it, and now Chandasāvak come down from the hollow moon.
eight.intro:b_warden: Something pale comes up over the bell on the stone.
eight.phase:b_warden.1: Pale lumps leave it in turning arms.
eight.phase:b_warden.2: Tama close in as its body starts to come apart.
eight.sight:b_sporemother: The dome over the floor was its own growth: cap and thread fastened to the roof. Everything it threw fell on us from above.
eight.kill:b_sporemother: Under the cap was thread, wrapped round the Guhamāt Remains. The censers taken with the smoke had become Antar metal.
eight.loss:b_sporemother: Nothing new came near us in the nights after. While it hung there its host stayed round it, fed by the cap it dropped. Now its packs may come up near our gate to the hollow.
eight.habit:b_sporemother: Its cap falls on marked ground, and we stand off the marks. Near the end it charges and slams with its own weight.
eight.once:b_sporemother: A Kavak formed on the floor where a piece of its falling cap had landed. The pieces are raw remains, and the lowest feeders form on them.
eight.said:b_sporemother: Guhamāt is the mother of the small caps in Under. It hangs from the roof until the smoke reaches it.
eight.intro:b_sporemother: Smoke reaches the roof of the dome, and the roof moves.
eight.phase:b_sporemother.1: A split opens in the cap. Light shows from inside.
eight.phase:b_sporemother.2: Most of its growth tears from the roof. It swings on what is left.
eight.sight:b_regent: Nothing came down to land. Something very large circled over the kite on the masts. Its bolts were bits of the same stuff as its body.
eight.kill:b_regent: Most of it weighed almost nothing: the pale stuff that hangs under the islands, which its kind feeds on. Its remains are a plume of the same stuff.
eight.loss:b_regent: Jatu fly over every country we walk now, where before they kept to the caves and the high rock. A held hearth still turns them, since they roost.
eight.habit:b_regent: It circles wide of the floor and high over it, and comes in only to stoop. We strike it as it stoops. Few lesser feeders come near the floor during the fight.
eight.once:b_regent: Jīmūt Remains from an earlier kill stood straight up from a hand as the kite went up. Above that hand the animal came down out of the air. We take that to point at the islands overhead.
eight.said:b_regent: Jīmūt flies and never lands, so no hearth turns it. The storm over its floor is Jīmūt itself.
eight.intro:b_regent: A pale flier, far larger than a Jatu, drops out of the high air.
eight.phase:b_regent.1: Strikes fall on marked ground all over the floor.
eight.phase:b_regent.2: It stoops lower, and more often.
eight.sight:b_luminarch: A body of dense crystal turned inside a ring of loose crystal. Rays left it in fans toward whoever was nearest.
eight.kill:b_luminarch: It broke into pieces of dense crystal with Ākās through them. The densest of those pieces is the Ratan Crystal.
eight.loss:b_luminarch: Its kinds stayed on the islands round it, where its crystal was. With it dead nothing holds them there, and the way off the islands is the gate we raised. None has come by it yet.
eight.habit:b_luminarch: The beam comes round slowly. A hunter who keeps moving stays out of it. It shifts from place to place over the stone, and its ring of pieces goes with it.
eight.once:b_luminarch: Its beam was on one of us. Next it hung across the floor with the beam on another. None of us saw it cross.
eight.said:b_luminarch: Nobody of ours has seen Ratan. They said it is a jewel far off past the second gate. Light the lens gathers calls it up.
eight.intro:b_luminarch: Pieces of crystal gather and begin to turn.
eight.phase:b_luminarch.1: Its rays sweep round in a spiral.
eight.phase:b_luminarch.2: Sakal form on the pieces that come away from it.
eight.sight:b_hart: On four running legs a body with tines came across the dark floor, glowing violet. It slammed the ground where we stood. Chandasāvak came up behind it.
eight.kill:b_hart: Kuranga was lees set hard, and its tines were the same lees grown outward.
eight.loss:b_hart: The next dark night the deep kind was up as before, with no strongest at its head now. Packs with nothing over them do not hold ground, so a Night raid may fall on a dark night from now on, it seems.
eight.habit:b_hart: Kuranga answers the mask only after dark. No charge on any floor is faster. Once its tines light, it stops being where we last saw it.
eight.once:b_hart: Our fight with it ran until dawn. When the sun came up it went back down. The sun undoes its kind.
eight.said:b_hart: Of the things from the hollow moon, Kuranga is the largest. Put on the mask at its altar, and Kuranga sees you.
eight.intro:b_hart: Hoofbeats come out of the dark toward the stone.
eight.phase:b_hart.1: Violet light runs along its tines.
eight.phase:b_hart.2: Between charges it is in one place and then another.
eight.sight:b_sovereign: Standing stones rode on top of a stack of dressed stone that rose out of the base into the air. Bright stones broke from its sides and flew at us.
eight.kill:b_sovereign: Nihān held what it had eaten of the housing: dressed stone, gems, lamps and Gahan. Arms lay in it, better than any store holds. Nihān Remains are the strongest raw remains anyone carries.
eight.loss:b_sovereign: Silahādak were on the surface after dark and came in with the dusk packs. The base under every Cairn we passed stood broken.
eight.habit:b_sovereign: When it drops onto the paving, the ground round it jumps. Its beam comes only after the stack has parted. Late in the fight Chandasāvak fall in behind it, with nothing else to follow.
eight.once:b_sovereign: After the kill we stood on the base and found it hollow under the paving. Clean gaps ran through it where the animal had eaten its way in.
eight.said:b_sovereign: When the great lees ran out, the forebears closed their first and best stone under the Cairn. Nihān lies in the base below that stone.
eight.intro:b_sovereign: Stone grinds and shifts inside the Cairn.
eight.phase:b_sovereign.1: The stack parts round a glowing middle.
eight.phase:b_sovereign.2: Gems and lamps it has eaten show through cracks in its stone.
eight.line:altar_waits: Nothing lies on the stone. Its bait is {a} {item}.
eight.line:dawn_down: {name} goes back down as the sun comes up.
eight.line:fallen.sub: What was in it lies on the floor
eight.line:night_only: Kuranga comes up here only after dark.
eight.line:withdraws: {name} goes back the way it came.
